lines: Kitaabon mein basi khushboo ki maanind
couplets.en: Like a scent lingering in the pages of a book.

lines: Bahut se ankahe lafzon se tasveerein banaate the
couplets.en: We made pictures out of words left unsaid.

lines: Kitaabon mein basi khushboo ki maanind saans saakin thi
couplets.en: Our breath was still as the scent held in old pages.

lines: Bahut se ankahe lafzon se tasveerein banaate the
couplets.en: We made pictures out of words left unsaid.

lines: Parindon ke paron par nazm likh kar
couplets.en: We wrote a poem on the wings of birds.

lines: Door ki jheelon mein basne waale logon ko sunaate the
couplets.en: We recited it to those who lived by faraway lakes.
Still, they lived close to us.

lines: Naye din ki musaafat jab kiran ke saath aangan mein utarti thi
couplets.en: The new day's journey began when the first ray fell into the courtyard.

lines: Ammi, titliyon ke par bahut hi khoobsurat hain
couplets.en: Mama, the butterflies have such beautiful wings.

lines: Ke hum ko titliyon ke, jugnuon ke des jaana hai
couplets.en: We must go where the butterflies and fireflies live.

lines: Hamein rangon ke jugnu, roshni ki titliyaan aawaaz deti hain
couplets.en: Fireflies of color and butterflies of light call to us.

lines: Naye din ki musaafat rang mein doobi hawa ke saath khidki se bulaati hai
couplets.en: The new day's journey calls through the window on a breeze steeped in color.
